title: The Haunting of Blackwood Manor
description: A gothic horror story where you explore a haunted manor

entrance.title: The Entrance
entrance.description: You stand before a crumbling manor, its windows like hollow eyes staring into the void. The iron gates creak ominously in the cold wind. A sense of dread washes over you.

choices.text: Push open the gates and enter
Wait and observe from a distance

courtyard.title: The Courtyard
courtyard.description: The gates groan as you push them open. A path of broken stones leads to the manor entrance. Mist swirls around your feet. You hear whispers in the wind.

observation.title: Watching from Afar
observation.description: You wait in the shadows. Minutes pass. Then you see it - a figure moving past an upper window. Someone... or something... is inside.

choices.text: Now is the time - approach the gates
This was a mistake - turn back

lobby.title: The Grand Lobby
lobby.description: The front door creaks open. Dust motes dance in the pale moonlight. A grand staircase rises before you, and corridors stretch into darkness on either side.

glimpse.title: A Glimpse Within
glimpse.description: Through the grime-covered window, you see a figure seated in a chair - motionless. Is it a statue? A corpse? Or something worse?

upstairs.title: The Upper Floor
upstairs.description: The staircase creaks beneath your feet. At the top, a long corridor stretches before you. Doors line both sides, and at the far end, a pale light flickers.

basement.title: The Basement
basement.description: The basement door groans open. Cold, damp air rushes up to meet you. Stone steps descend into pitch darkness. You hear dripping water... and something else.

bedroom.title: The Master Bedroom
bedroom.description: A four-poster bed dominates the room. On it lies a figure - preserved as if sleeping. As you approach, its eyes snap open.

crypt.title: The Crypt
crypt.description: Ancient coffins line the walls. In the center, an altar glows with an unholy light. You've found the heart of the manor's curse.

finale.title: The Final Chamber
finale.description: You enter a room filled with candles. A figure in white stands at the window. She turns, her face both beautiful and terrible. 'You've come at last,' she whispers.

ending_flee.title: THE END - Flight
ending_flee.description: You turn and flee. The manor's secrets remain hidden, but you live to see another day. Perhaps some doors are better left unopened...

ending_fight.title: THE END - Confrontation
ending_fight.description: You stand your ground as the figure rises. In that moment of terror, you find courage you never knew. The creature recoils from your defiance and retreats into shadow. You survive.

ending_escape.title: THE END - Escape
ending_escape.description: You flee through the manor, bursting through doors and windows until you reach the outside. Behind you, the manor stands silent once more. You escaped... this time.

ending_victory.title: THE END - Victory
ending_victory.description: You smash the altar. A scream echoes through the manor as the curse is broken. Light floods the basement. You have freed Blackwood Manor from its dark past.

ending_embrace.title: THE END - Embrace
ending_embrace.description: You take her hand. The candles flicker and go out. When morning comes, you are gone - but you are not alone. You have become part of Blackwood's eternal story.
